Christmas Tree Decorations
These Christmas tree decorations add a festive detail to your Christmas display. Their black finish is easy to coordinate with the surrounding setting.

Lightweight Design
The lightweight form is convenient to handle and move between suitable locations. It also makes the item easier to include when organising a bag or storage space.

Compact Format
The compact format helps the item fit into a smaller working or storage area. It is useful where you want the function close to hand without filling the whole space.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

Plan the display
Choose a suitable support or display position for the size and form of the product. Allow enough space around it for the room to remain practical, and use the stated indoor or outdoor suitability when deciding where it should be placed.

Care and presentation
Follow the care guidance for the stated material and handle decorative details gently. When the display changes, store the piece where its surface and shape will be supported, ready to bring out again for the next arrangement.

Freely Placed Cordless Decor: This ornament needs 2 AAA batteries not included, no exposed wires limit your placement. Recording and playback controls are integrated on the bottom base for convenient use.
Cherishable Voice Keepsake Gift: Send it as a precious Christmas gift to your parents, grandparents, partners, children and friends, it preserves seasonal voice memories and carries warm feelings year after year.

Gather around the table and enjoy some quality family time with the Buttonbag Clay Decorations Kit! This wonderful clay making kit provides the perfect opportunity to bring the whole family together, allowing parents and children to chat, laugh, and connect over a shared project. These kit make fantastic creative activities for families who want to step away from screens, fire up their imaginations, and explore crafting together. Unbox a complete craft collection that comes packed with everything you need to shape your own unique designs! Inside, you will find smooth air dry clay that hardens naturally without needing an oven, plus a handy wooden rolling pin, sculpting tools, and shaped cutters. When it is time for the clay decorating stage, the pack is loaded with a lovely palette of paints, paintbrushes, bright craft threads, and decorative beads to help bring up to 5 individual ornaments to life. While children are busy sculpting and painting, these engaging craft sets for kids are quietly providing fantastic developmental rewards. Working with clay is an excellent way to unlock imagination and creativity, letting young artists experiment freely with custom textures and colour combinations. From rolling and cutting to painting and threading, mini-makers will naturally build fine motor skills and hand-eye coordination, boosting their confidence with every finished decoration.
Includes air dry clay, 60 colourful beads, paint, threads & tools
Clay hardens overnight without the need for oven baking; comes with instructions for 5 playful designs
Mould their imaginations & creativity & enjoy making & painting your own ornaments
This decoration crafting set makes a great birthday or Christmas gift for creative boys & girls
Specialising in all-in-one craft kits, Buttonbag makes creativity simple, portable & rewarding

A mix of warm white and cool white micro LEDs is set off by pearl accents, giving a layered, glistening finish with a 20% flashing effect for extra sparkle. Pair it with other MySmartBuy light up figures, trees and wreaths to build a full festive display that neighbours, visitors and passers-by will love. 5056903229272.variantName: 17cm Glitter Eucalyptus with Maple Leaf Pick Dark Green 6pcs
5056903229272.sourceDescription:
Bring decorative colour, sparkle and seasonal detail to Christmas displays with this set of 6 mint green artificial eucalyptus with maple leaf picks, each measuring 17 cm. Designed with glittered eucalyptus with maple-style leaves and flexible wired stems, these decorative pick stems can be bent and shaped to suit different arrangements and display styles. They are perfect decorative accents for fuller arrangement showcases. They can also be arranged around wreaths and garlands, placed in vases and centrepieces, or incorporated into bouquets, mantel displays and other festive floral arrangements. The glittered leaves provide added colour, texture and sparkle, helping to introduce a decorative finish to seasonal displays. The wired stems make positioning easier, allowing the picks to be attached anywhere in floral arrangements and other decorative elements. Suitable for Christmas trees, wreaths, garlands, vases, table centrepieces, bouquets, gift displays and DIY craft projects, these artificial eucalyptus with maple leaf picks can be used as standalone decorative accents or combined with other Christmas decorations and floral pieces. The mint green colour can be incorporated into a range of festive decorating themes, from traditional seasonal arrangements to more coordinated displays. With a 17cm stem length and 6-piece quantity, this set provides flexible options for decorating different areas around the home, festive event spaces, or floral craft projects.
EUCALYPTUS WITH MAPLE LEAF PICKS MINT GREEN 6 PCS 17 CM: Includes 6 mint green glitter eucalyptus with maple leaf picks measuring 17 cm, featuring decorative leaves and flexible wired stems for arranging on Christmas trees, wreaths, garlands, vases, centrepieces, bouquets and festive floral displays
FLEXIBLE WIRED STEMS: The wired stems can be bent and shaped to suit different arrangements, making these artificial eucalyptus and maple leaf picks easy to position around Christmas trees, wreaths, garlands, floral displays, bouquets, and DIY decorations
GLITTERED EUCALYPTUS WITH MAPLE LEAVES: Glittered leaves add sparkle, colour and texture to festive arrangements, providing decorative accents for Christmas trees, wreath fillers, garlands, table centrepieces, mantel displays, vases and seasonal floral decorations
VERSATILE FESTIVE DECOR: Suitable for Christmas trees, wreaths, garlands, vases, bouquets, table centrepieces, mantel decorations, gift displays and DIY crafts; ideal for seasonal home decor, festive parties, weddings and floral arrangements
DIY FLORAL ARRANGEMENTS: The full floral eucalyptus with maple stems features perfect decorative accents for fuller arrangements. Bend, attach, and position the wired stems to customise Christmas displays, wreaths, garlands, bouquets, vases, and festive craft projects
Indoor Use

8956086258472.variantName: 12 Pack Burgundy Velvet Christmas Bows 23.5 x 15.5 Inch Large Xmas Tree Wreath Staircase Fireplace Decoration
8956086258472.sourceDescription:
This set includes 12 burgundy velvet Christmas bows, giving you enough matching decorations to dress a tree, staircase or mantelpiece evenly. Each bow measures about 23.5 x 15.5 inches (60 x 40 cm), with a ribbon width of 0.98 inch (2.5 cm), so they read as generous statement pieces rather than small filler bows. If a bow arrives squashed or creased, simply fluff it by hand or press it lightly with an iron and it springs back into shape without losing its form.

The bows are made from soft velvet with a dense, sturdy pile that holds its shape and keeps a rich burgundy tone under tree lights. The fabric feels substantial in the hand and resists flattening, so the loops stay plump through the season and can be packed away for reuse the following year. Twelve identical bows also make it easy to keep the spacing consistent across a large wreath, a garland or a full tree.

Use them on the tree, wreaths, stair rails, mantelpieces, doors, windows, fences, fireplaces or gift boxes. The deep burgundy sits well with gold, ivory or tartan schemes and suits Christmas parties, drinks evenings and other themed gatherings.

A ready-made set for anyone decorating a large tree or a whole room, and a straightforward gift for friends, neighbours, family or colleagues who like traditional Christmas styling.
Guarantee - 1 month

Used by growers and retailers to wrap trees securely for transportation without damaging tree branches.

To find out what size netting you require, measure the diameter of the small end of your tree netting funnel. 
The netting diameter closest to your measurement will be the one you need.

Colour: White

What is oxo-biodegradable plastic?
Oxo-biodegradable plastic is ordinary plastic to which small amounts of metal salts (a prodegradant additive) has been added during the manufacturing process. The resulting plastic is then made into products like carrier bags, produce or courier bags, straws and other short-life/single-use items. The big difference between oxo-biodegradable and ordinary plastic is that if oxo-biodegradable plastic escapes collection and ends up in the open environment as litter, it will degrade and biodegrade in a similar way to nature’s waste.

How does it work?
In the presence of oxygen, the prodegradant additive breaks the molecular chains in the polymer, and at the end of its useful life the product will degrade and biodegrade, that is it will be consumed by bacteria and fungi, after the additive has reduced the molecular weight to a level which permits them access to the carbon and hydrogen. 

For more detail, please download the document available.
